name: Mockup canvas
description: A design canvas with one screen to start, a sticky for open questions, and room for more boards on pages.
instructions: Before you draw, ask which screens or flow to mock and who will use them, unless the Session already says. Each board is a plain HTML file with its own styles, drawn at its frame's size; there is no template language, so write the real markup. List every board in canvas.json under boards, keyed by its file, with its frame (x, y, w and h in canvas pixels), a title such as B. Checkout: pay, and its page id from pages, and add it to order. Lay boards out left to right, 80 pixels apart, one row per flow. Link one board to the next with a plain <a href="Next.html">, so Play follows the flow. Put questions and assumptions in notes in canvas.json, keyed by an id with x, y, text and page, not on the boards; a note with "kind": "title1" is a heading over a row, and title2 or title3 a smaller one. Set launch.page to the page the canvas opens on. People add stickies of their own, which read_artifact lists: answer them with a note beside them, or move or remove one with update_canvas_sticky. Use real labels and plausible data from the Session, never filler text. Publish the folder with entry Main.html. When you later build these screens, read the canvas with read_artifact and compare each board with what you built, by screenshots in your Environment's browser.
